seo.title: DFS: personalized welcome series on Bloomreach - +4.2% conversion (2024)
seo.meta_description: DFS personalizes its welcome series on Bloomreach Engagement and Loomi from zero-party data: +4.2% conversion and +3.9% revenue versus control.
seo.resume_citable: DFS gained +4.2% conversion and +3.9% revenue on its welcome series by personalizing email content from zero-party data with Bloomreach Engagement and Loomi, a program run with the agency CACI.

faq.q: How does DFS personalize its welcome emails?
faq.a: By asking the new contact what they are looking for (zero-party data), then automatically routing the matching guide and Loomi product recommendations in Bloomreach Engagement.
Against a control group with no personalization, +4.2% conversion rate and +3.9% revenue on the welcome series.

pattern: Welcome series personalized on zero-party data with AI product recommendation
objectif_business: Bridge the gap between rare, expensive furniture purchases by engaging new contacts early with content matched to what they are actually looking for.
description: DFS, the UK's leading sofa retailer, engages its new contacts with an automated welcome series on Bloomreach Engagement. The brand first asks the customer what interests them (zero-party data via the what's your thing question), then the flow automatically sends the matching guide, for example a bedroom furniture buying guide if the customer is interested, and invites them into the showroom at the right point in the journey. Loomi provides the personalized product recommendation layer.
points_cles: Welcome series personalized on zero-party data with AI product recommendation.
Bloomreach Engagement and Loomi, plus an ML algorithm from the agency CACI.
+4.2% conversion and +3.9% revenue versus control, +866% revenue on the CACI campaign.

resultats.metrique: Conversion rate of the welcome series (versus a control group with no personalization)
Revenue of the welcome series (versus the control group)
Revenue of an email campaign driven by CACI's ML algorithm (within 14 days)

niveau_preuve.justification: Quantified Bloomreach customer story (welcome series) and a quantified case study from the agency CACI (ML email campaign). Two interested but concordant sources on DFS's AI email program; no third-party press, hence B.

stack_technique.detail: CRM engagement platform that collects the zero-party data and orchestrates the branched flows of the welcome series
Bloomreach's AI layer that personalizes product recommendation in the emails
model built by the agency on transactional history, behind the +866% revenue email campaign
DFS's data activation and engagement strategy partner

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: Event-driven: the welcome series triggers on signup and branches according to the customer's answer.
fonctionnement_operationnel.opere_par: DFS's CRM / data team, with the agency CACI on the engagement strategy.
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: The zero-party data (what the customer says they are looking for). Without this answer, the flow does not know which guide or category to push and falls back to a generic message.

etapes.detail: The customer answers the what's your thing question, which captures their furniture category of interest.
Bloomreach Engagement routes to the matching guide (for example bedroom) based on the answer.
Loomi personalizes the recommended products in the email.
The series invites the customer into the store at the right point in the journey for an in-person try.

prerequis_data: a mechanism to collect zero-party data (preference questionnaire)
prerequis_orga: a CRM team able to build branched flows
coordination between email and the physical network for considered purchases
stack_possible: any CRM platform with conditional flows and AI product recommendation
replication.premiere_etape: Add a preference question at signup, then wire a welcome flow that routes content based on the answer.

playbook.action: Add the preference question at signup (which product category the contact is interested in).
playbook.livrable: Zero-party data collection active on new signups

playbook.action: Build the branched welcome flow that routes content (guides, categories) based on the answer.
Wire the AI product recommendation into the series emails.
Set a control group with no personalization to measure the real gap.
playbook.livrable: Active A/B test with documented split

playbook.action: Read conversion and revenue against the control, then generalize the series and add the showroom invitation at the right moment.
playbook.livrable: Quantified readout and generalized welcome series

replication.equipe: 1 CRM manager + 1 email integrator / designer, with a data agency optional for the ML layer

statut_vivant.note: Bloomreach keeps the DFS case online with the mention of Loomi (a current AI product). CACI is an official Bloomreach partner.

transposable_ue.note: Already deployed in the EU (Spain, Ireland). Collecting zero-party data through an explicit questionnaire is fairly GDPR-friendly (data provided and consented).
